changelog:
Initial release of the Alibaba Cloud DDoS Pro (ddoscoo) domain-level configuration backup and migration skill.

- Enables full export and import of Layer 7 (website) DDoS Pro domain configurations in YAML v2.0 format.
- Supports disaster recovery backup, configuration audit, rollback, and batch import of domain settings across 20 configuration areas.
- Strictly limited to domain-level (website) business; Layer 4 TCP/UDP port forwarding is not supported (see sister skill).
- Requires explicit user confirmation on all parameters including region, domain scope, and file paths, with warnings on region isolation.
- Enforces critical operational rules: session-based user-agent tagging, credential best practices, and RAM permission checks.
- Compatible with aliyun CLI >= 3.3.1.
